narration: For {identical_months} months, the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. By month {first_bar_apart_month}, {first_bar_apart}, the measure of how long you could last with no pay, had already come apart. When the layoff hit both of you in month {layoff_month}, the ghost stood {layoff_net_worth_gap}. At month {end_month}, the ghost ended with {net_worth_gap}. The ghost's sense of actually living, rather than just getting through, ended {life_gap}.
